title: sse: fix streaming chunking/framing for partial JSON, delimiter edgecases, and token ordering
author: Diego Morales
description:
Background: several customers and internal canaries reported malformed/partial JSON objects in SSE streams when responses include structured output or tool/function-calling payloads. Root causes: (1) the streamer was splitting byte chunks on token boundaries without accounting for JSON tokenization, producing events that cut objects in half; (2) delimiter handling between events relied on double-newline but racey path sometimes emitted single-newline separators; (3) ordering of internal token flush vs event 'done' marker could lead to the final object being emitted after the done event. This PR fixes chunking and framing logic in the SSE runtime and OpenAI-compat adapter so that partial JSON fragments are buffered until syntactically complete object frames can be emitted (within a configurable safety window), ensures consistent "

" event delimiters, and guarantees deterministic token/event ordering for done/close events. Includes unit and integration tests that reproduce the customer cases, and adds a stress test for interleaved function-calling payloads.
commits: 3a7f2c8: sse: add safeBuffer to accumulate partial JSON fragments and heuristic end-of-object detection
a1f4b77: openai_compat: route structured output through safeBuffer to avoid partial-event emission
d9c8ee0: sse: normalize event delimiter to "\n\n" and centralize flush logic
f2b3a11: ts-client: handle multi-chunk JSON frames in sse.ts parser
e4c6d22: tests: add unit/integration tests for partial-json and done-ordering regressions
b18f0a3: docs: add streaming note and recommended retry semantics (non-breaking)
discussion:
Ava Chen (reviewer): Found a race where the final chunk could be emitted after the done event. Suggest centralizing the flush logic and adding an explicit done-then-flush order check.

Diego Morales (author): Implemented central flush queue and added deterministic ordering; added a safety window (100ms) heuristic that buffers partial JSON until we see an object boundary or the safety window expires.

Priya Nair: Tests look good, but the safety window value should be configurable via streamer config; otherwise LGTM.

Diego Morales: Exposed streamer.safety_window_ms with default 100 and added documentation. CI initially failed on a flaky test; fixed by increasing test timeouts for the stress harness.

Linus Park: Verified end-to-end with loadtest with structured outputs containing nested objects — no partial JSON observed. Approve and recommend backport to release/1.12 for customer-facing fixes.
release_notes: Fix: SSE streaming emitted partial JSON objects for structured outputs and functionCalling payloads. Improves reliability by buffering partial fragments, normalizing delimiters, and fixing event ordering. Customers on streaming APIs may see fewer JSON parse errors.
test_summary: Unit tests: 42 passed, 0 failed. Integration tests: 6 passed, 0 failed. Stress test: reproduced prior failure locally before fix; after fix no partial-json events observed under 10k requests. CI flake on sse stress test rerun fixed.
notes: Backport requested to release/1.12 due to customer impact. Telemetry alert ENG-SSE-PARTIALJSON was muted and will be updated to look for the new framing fields.
